# foliate-js (vendored)

The book engine behind NovelCheck's reader (`web/static/reader.html`, `js/reader*.js`): EPUB, MOBI/AZW3, FB2 and
comic-book files, paginated, in sandboxed frames.

- Source: https://github.com/johnfactotum/foliate-js
- Version: commit 78914aef4466eb960965702401634c2cb348e9b1 (2026-05-01)
- License: MIT (`LICENSE` here), by John Factotum
- Left out: PDF (`pdf.js` and pdf.js itself), read-aloud (`tts.js`), dictionaries, OPDS, the demo reader.

To update, copy the same files from a newer commit and note it here.
